name: digest
description: Summary, chapters with timestamps, and key points from a transcript, optionally with notes on what appears on screen.

verbs.name: make
verbs.description: Digest one transcript file, plus image notes when given. Prints the summary, or the digest with --json. Cached by transcript and image notes hash, model, and prompt hash. Refuses with budget_exceeded once today's model spend reaches the daily budget.

transcript.description: Path of a transcript JSON file, as captions or transcribe print it with --json.

imageNotes.description: Path of an image-notes JSON file whose images carry a time. Adds the visual field.
